frozen_train_probe.limitation: The fixed seed probe derives from 10k seed data with zero damage and thus equals RAW targets on these same windows. It is an in-replay shaped-head fit proxy, not held-out prediction or direct evidence that damage shaping improves the raw-world model. Zero positive terminal labels preclude event-recall inference.
